purpose: Run persistent multi-actor narrative worlds as concurrent event arcs, games, scenes and rounds before Storyteller selects and renders prose.
architecture: world -> event_arc -> game -> scene -> round -> action_collision -> writeback

requirements: at least two meaningful strategic branches for nontrivial Games
at least one counterplay path against plausible dominant strategies
public or durable evidence sufficient for skilled inference when deduction is part of the Game
fixed backstage truth for mystery/information Games
no single actor controls almost all critical action space unless that imbalance itself is the Game
failure and deadlock remain legal outcomes
event arc should not reskin the same mechanic bundle across every Game

active_event_arc.next_trigger: batch-3 manifest lacks manual_followup_status; hospital-side rerun context must be reconstructed before briefing language can safely converge

prohibited_crossing: Storyteller may not rewrite StoryBox truth to improve drama
StoryBox may not force an outcome to satisfy a literary arc
Storyteller may hide truth from reader but may not change it
StoryBox may end a game in deadlock, failure or partial resolution
Game-local information does not automatically synchronize across games
An actor is not globally good/bad because of a local stance in one game
Moderator may not invent evidence solely to restore excitement or balance

scene_definition.start: a bounded location/channel/time window opens with a concrete local trigger and at least one legal participant action
end: new evidence or actor changes the action set
all local actors act/pass and no local move remains
scene_definition.important_rule: A scene may end without resolving its parent game. A novel chapter may render part of one scene, one scene, or selected material from several scenes.

round_definition.start: a material trigger changes what at least one eligible actor can or must do inside the current scene/game
end: all eligible actors have acted/passed for the current trigger
hard interrupt changes the action set

concurrent_game_rules.role_locality: actor role, stake and stance are recorded per game; no global hero/villain tag
concurrent_game_rules.actor_concurrency: soft capacity may be exceeded with fatigue/coordination costs; hard capacity may not be exceeded without a hard-world capacity change
concurrent_game_rules.high_influence_effect: high-power/high-delegation/high-coordination actors can sustain more simultaneous games, but accumulate cross-game commitments and contradiction risk

event_node_rules.pre_event_convergence: multiple games/scenes may need to converge before a hard event node becomes ready
event_node_rules.event_firing: event node mutates hard world only after auditable predicates are satisfied
event_node_rules.post_event: event firing may open/close games, change map, authority, deadlines, public information or resource constraints

anti_filler.zero_delta_rule: Repeated rounds with no material truth/info/belief/power/relationship/map/resource/deadline/mystery change terminate as deadlock or equilibrium.
anti_filler.no_chat_for_chat_rule: Conversation alone is not a material delta unless it changes information, belief, commitment, relationship evidence, authority, resource or future action set.
anti_filler.no_scene_for_atmosphere_rule: A scene must alter local state/action space or justify a convergence/deadlock result.
anti_filler.no_forced_breakthrough: If actors lack evidence or legal moves, record the deadlock; do not invent discovery to keep the plot moving.

character_rules.new_actor_entry: only when an active scene/game reaches their role, information, authority, interest, location or existing relationship

round_history.material_change: timestamp mismatch turns one suspicious list into a multi-run incident; all overnight batches are frozen; technical-operations map unlocks
three runs reconstructed; rollback confirmed but single-cause explanation weakened; hospital/data-snapshot map unlocks; missing manual-followup table becomes actionable

next_actions: audit the four risk-list Game mechanic profiles with game_director_v17 before activating new Games
materialize a hospital-side Scene for Round 3; allow multiple rounds inside that scene if the action set changes without participants separating
reconstruct why manual_followup_status was absent and who requested the rerun
permit verified facts to spill from cause-reconstruction into 72h-briefing only through an explicit report/evidence bridge
do not activate research, industry or additional core actors merely for ensemble breadth
after the hospital scene evaluate both scene convergence and each affected game's convergence/event-node readiness
